nom: The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Rice Bran Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

avis.titre: This product is STAYING in the skincare rotation!
avis.texte: This product is PERFECT. It's gently exfoliates my skin and brightens it. Over time I noticed it was lightening up my dark spots from acne. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean. Not to mention, it smells sooo good. It's not harsh at all nor irritating. I LOVE it! Will forever use!!
This daily scrub is gentle on the skin and does not dry you out. I love that it does not contain sulfates or parabens. It works well with combo skin.

The face shop Rice Water Bright I was unaware of this brand before until I was kindly gifted this amazing exfoliating cleanser. This is an amazing K-beauty brand cleanser. Love the hydration the scent is very comfortable. The size of the product is huge and can last for a while. Since I have added this to my morning skincare routine I'm excited to see the results afterwards. The most important benefits of this cleanser are that it contains vitamins A, B, and E, minerals, and ceramide to brighten and nourish dry skin. And the natural ingredients that will help remove the impurities while leaving skin soft, supple, and evenly toned.
I love how gentle this face wash is on my sensitive skin. It lathers up rather nicely and washes off easily. Best of all it leaves your skin clean without stripping away anything.

I received this for review purposes in exchange for my honest feedback. I am using it almost every day. Gives perfect exfoliation and makes skin glowing and super soft. Small granules and smooth texture I want to use on my face again and again. Moreover it smells amazing.

Such a game-changer! This cleanser cleans the skin well and removes makeup without leaving my skin feeling dry and dehydrated. My skin looks so fresh, clean, and glowy within just a few uses. I have some light acne scars and this cleanser has worked it's magic on them within just a few weeks, creating a more even skin tone.
Loved this cleanser just enough exfoliation to get skin bright and clean without over drying

My skin feels so clean and hydrated after using this Rice Water bright Rice bran gentle Exfoliating Cleanser - the texture is grainy so perfect for exfoliating skin and smells amazing too. After using it regularly for 2 weeks I definitely recommend it to fellow skincare enthusiasts.

I have used The Body Shop rice water oil cleanser in the past and liked it so was excited with the opportunity to try their rice exfoliating cleanser. This is a cream to foam cleanser that is gentle yet very effect, leaving my skin supple and soft, squeaky clean even! Really like this for after the shower use
This cleanser is very gentle and lightweight. The cleanser effectively removes the makeup and other products I had on my face. Looking forward to the results of this cleanser with more use.

Thank you BZzagent and The Face Shop for this gifting me this product in exchange for my honest review. I have never heard of this brand previously and I am pleasantly surprised by the performance of this product. I have rosacea so I'm usually skeptical skeptical of any exfoliating wash but this foam cleanser uses rice and rice bran extract creating a super gentle experience. It removed my makeup with ease and did not leave my face feeling stripped. I'm impressed.

Wow, wow, wow! If you haven't got your hands on this product you are missing out on some amazing results! Let me tell you why I'm wowed! First it's packaging is pretty. It's a good quality size for the price. It works better than Any skincare exfoliating cleanser I've ever ever tried, and I've tried many from drug store brands to high end prestige brands and this amazed me with the results i got with the first use. I was hooked on this brand and I am super excited to try other skincare products from Avon's the body shop. It's texture is wonderful and it foams up a wonderful lather that my skin loved. I started out using this cleanser twice a week to allow my skin to adjust to a new cleanser. It's super helpful at removing dirt, makeup, pollutants, and any other stuff. It's gentle for even sensitive skin, just remember to follow the directions on the back of the packaging. It is packed with great skincare ingredients that my skin was needing. I have noticed my makeup looks better when I apply my foundation cause I have a good skincare routine that helped a lot. I'm excited to tell all my friends about Rice Water Bright Rice Bran gentle exfoliating cleanser. It's been great for my skin and I'm sure you'll like it as much as I do! You can thank me later!
It is gentle that it leaves your skin soft but has a great exfoliator to take off those dead skin cells as well

I enjoyed using this cleanser, it feels nice and leaves my skin feeling soft since it is exfoliating . I like the fact that this is a gentle exfoliater and overall my skin has been looking more smooth.
It is a very pleasant product for my skin, I love the feeling it leaves after use.
I think this product is just fine for the price point, but I've had better honestly. The fragrance was irritating which is disappointing. Worth a try but wasn't for me.

I Love The Smell Of This Cleanser In It Get Very Sudsy Which Is Perfect Because That How I Like My Cleansers I Notice A Difference In My Face After One Use I Can't Wait To Finish The Bottle In See My Results

I love this product it really cleans my face really well and is sure to remove all products from my face without leaving a residue . A little goes a long way so you're getting your moneys worth with this product!! I've noticed a positive difference in my skin after a few uses and I can't wait to keep using it!
This is a good exfoliator for those who don't want to use something harsh and abrasive. Helps skin feel smoother without feeling tight or abraded.
Love this cleanser and the exfoliating beads, after using it regularly I've noticed brighter glowing skin.
This product is so gentle but effective. Little goes a long way. Keeps my face smooth and soft after use. Highly recommended

A little dollop of this cleanser goes a long way! It foams up a ton, so I only use a tiny amount. This cleanser leaves my skin feeling soft, clean, and hydrated. I appreciate that it provides multiple benefits, as it provides some light exfoliation as well. I recommend this cleanser!

I've been using this cleanser for about 2 weeks now. It's super gentle on my sensitive skin and effective at taking off my sunscreen and light makeup. Makes my skin feel fresh and bright. I'll be continuing to use this cleanser until I run out.

I love how tight and tone it makes my face and it give me a squeaky clean feeling after I wash my face. I love that the ingredients are simple and clean and leaves the skin feeling plush and moisturized. This a great everyday cleanser that won't dry out your skin

I absolutely loved the smell and texture of this product. It went on creamy but definitely had some texture that was great for exfoliation. The only reason I gave it a 3 was because it did have a lot of unrecognizable ingredients and i like to have minimally made beauty products. Also, I did break out more with this product compared to my prior one.

I loved this exfoliating cleaser. I usually stay away from exfoliating cleanser because my skin is so sensitive and dry but this is perfect my face doesn't feel overly dry. I love how it does a great job at making your skin feel clean I would totally recommend giving this a try
This is an amazing exfoliating cleaner. It definitely makes your face clean and refreshed.

The hype is real! I had heard about the benefits of rice water all over the internet! I have hyper pigmentation and I can see my skin getting brighter and the marks fading. It leaves my skin hydrated while removing the dead skin! i can't wait to try the other products in the line

avis.titre: This rice water exfoliating cleaner is awesome
avis.texte: Love how this product makes my feel soft and smooth after first use clean. Will continue to use!!

**Fantastic Exfoliating Cleanser!** I've been using the Rice Water Bright Rice Bran Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser for a few weeks now, and I must say, it's become a staple in my skincare routine. The gentle exfoliating action leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and smooth without any irritation. I love how it effectively removes dead skin cells and impurities, revealing a brighter complexion underneath. Plus, the subtle rice scent is refreshing and soothing. Overall, I highly recommend this cleanser for anyone looking to achieve radiant and rejuvenated skin!
This exfoliating cleanser was way more gentle than I was expecting. I typically avoid exfoliating because of my sensitive skin, but this product caused no irritation for me!

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this cleanser !
avis.texte: The Face Shop sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program and I'm so glad I was able to try it out! This face wash was different from other face washes I've tried because it didn't break me out during my first use. Normally I would have some reaction but this one didn't cause any reaction for me. The texture is a very thick and creamy texture but it suds up very well. It wasn't too drying but my face did feel a little tight after washing. What's great is the exfoliation isn't too harsh it's the perfect level of physical exfoliation that I feel wouldn't be damaging to the skin. Just from the creamy texture, how it wasn't irritating, and the potential benefits to brighten the skin and keep it smooth, I would definitely purchase this face wash and recommend that others try it. Also it smells really nice , not like a perfume scent just a creamy fresh sent, but more creamy. I will continue to use it as it has proven to be a quality product thus far!

I got this for free from Bzzagent and The Face Shop in exchange of my honest review. I'm totally in love with this rice bran gentle exfoliating cleanser. It is so gentle that I use it daily and my skin looks brighter than ever. It has a very good scent and makes a lot of foam so a little goes a long way. It is very moisturizing and non greasy. My face had never felt so soft, smooth and healthy as it looks now. I have already recommended it to some family members and I definitely recommend it if you want a healthier skin complexion.

This is by far my new favorite cleanser. The tiniest amount goes so far! I mean pea size is more than enough. It doesn't dry my skin out or break it out and I have very sensitive skin. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: On my way to glass skin!
avis.texte: I couldn't have received this product at a better time, considering I was looking for a new exfoliator. I've used it for a week now and I love it! The exfoliant is mild and not abrasive, has a soft but noticeable fragrance, and aside from a tiny bit of skin purging, my face seems to love it! It goes on really thick when applied, but a little goes a long way. I use it daily and I'm happy to have something my skin enjoys!

It leaves your face fabulously soft and hydrated. To say that it fascinated me is an understatement. I am amazed by it and how well it does its job with the skin. From the first day I use it, you notice the difference. 100% recommended. Needless to say, it is super added to my skin care and of course I will continue buying it, it is very worth it 🫶🏻❤️😍🫶🏻❤️

avis.titre: This cleanser is not it for me
avis.texte: I like how well this cleanser lathers and it feels incredibly nourishing on my skin. However this product burns my sensitive eyes and I'm very careful when I apply it to my face. I have tried many other products similar to this one but this formula in particular is not my favorite. I do not intend to purchase this facial cleaner in the near future.
It feels really nice in my face because it leaves it very soft, hydrated, not dry, easy to apply, only needs a little for one application, lathers well, washes off quickly, smells very nice.
Having received the sample and really really fall in love with it. The smell is so natural and good, make my face soft feeling and clean fresh

I really liked the Rice water exfoliating cleanser! It has tiny granuals in it that make exfoliation not too rough but a perfect amount. My skin doesn't real tight or extra dry with this as well which is a plus. The only thing I didn't like was the fragrance, but even then it wasn't too bad just a light soapy vanilla. The lather was nice as well, it was foamy and creamy which feels lux. But I do have sensitive skin and don't love fragrance in skincare. Overall I really liked it!
I have received the face shop cleanser Rice Water Bright i so excited to use it

This is the most gentle exfoliant facial cleanser I've ever used. I have sensitive and comb skin. It actually did a great job on cleaning. My skin feels so soft and refreshing after every wash. The smell is very pleasant. My new favorite cleanser now!

This cleanser is super creamy and gives a nice rich lather. The exfoliation is definitely gentle and does not cause any irritation. I have sensitive skin and my skin loves this. Your skin will feel moisturized after using this cleanser. I definitely will be adding this cleanser into my routine.

The smell alone is enough for me to repurchase! It provides a gentle exfoliation but where this product really shines is the lather. Its a thick, plush, luxurious moisturizing feel when it foams up. Amazing

I have never tried "rice water" before getting my hands on rice water exfoliating cleaner. This is definitely different than my usual cleaners, but is a great way. This is definitely the most gentle cleanser I have ever used! My face and neck, when I say soft and smooth, there's no denying how much of an improvement this has made! My skin feels so soft, smooth and the texture has improved so much. It's made a huge difference with how makeup goes on and looks. I use this twice a day, morning and night and gives me the perfect lather. My skin isn't dry at all and absolutely doesn't affect any other facial products I use. I absolutely recommend this! I wish I would have known about this rice water cleanser by the Face Shop. I am so thankful I was able to try this in exchange for my honest feedback. My face thanks you and is brighter than ever!

avis.titre: The Face Shop's Rice Water Bright Cleanser
avis.texte: The Face Shop's Rice Water Bright Rice Bran Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser is a total game-changer! The fine, granular texture gently exfoliates, leaving my skin feeling incredibly smooth and refreshed. The rice bran infusion gives it a unique touch, and the subtle fragrance is both calming and refreshing. It effectively removes impurities without over-drying, making it perfect for daily use. My complexion looks brighter and more radiant since incorporating this into my routine. It's become a staple in my skincare regimen, and I can't recommend it enough!
